## Pre-PR Verification Checklist

Please verify that you have completed the following steps before opening this PR:

- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (`make format`).
- [ ] I have run linter checks and resolved all warnings (`make lint`).
- [ ] I have executed unit tests and template validation suites (`make verify`).
- [ ] I have added appropriate tests for any new features or bug fixes.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation in `Docs/` or `README.md` if applicable.
- [ ] My branch was created via `make dev` and is up to date with `main` (`make sync`).
